timing.pilot_clock_definition: After protocol/source verification through the last measured arm; caller imports and final result serialization/sealing are separate overhead
boundary_notes: Recorder wall/resource counters end before remaining parquet/seal writes; caller imports and subsequent report work are not fully covered.

Arm wall includes initialization, physics/support diagnostics, rendering, progress callbacks and final memory sampling. Its elapsed sample precedes final fixture-summary materialization; process CPU endpoint follows that materialization.
Arm CPU is process-wide including all recorder threads; telemetry work may overlap. Summed arm CPU is a subset-like diagnostic window, not an additional charge to whole-run CPU.
Per-arm timing has one fixed-order measurement; Windows process CPU readings have visible timer quantization. No confidence interval or optimal world-count claim is supported.

experience.counting_note: Fixture instances execute fixed diagnostic horizons, not episode outcome lifecycles. Seed prefixes are reused across world-count/render arms; instance count is not independent scenario count.

system_prior_cost.classification: engine installation and synthetic simulator-construction prior; not policy pretraining
system_prior_cost.cost_note: Each run counted once. Installation wall is already included in run wall, and arm costs are not added again. Missing setup/development/child CPU stays unknown. Separate run intervals do not establish an end-to-end calendar learning clock.

operator_context.source_isolation: Root reports execution from committed pinned worktree; canonical provenance records exact SHA and clean source at capture.
operator_context.concurrency: Operator reports no local research training, test suite or native capture during this pilot; report editing occurred outside the pinned source. Other game/application processes remained present.
operator_context.verification_limit: No exclusive host or device attribution is established by those operational reports. Recorded GPU activity is device-wide across processes.

interpretation.numerical_scope: Three synthetic fixture kinds, seed31000 repeated identically for diagnosis; arm worlds use seed31000+index. No multi-run timing replication. End chassis rotation near-9.5rad in driven fixtures is not a survival/vehicle-control success criterion.

next_step: Use this engine as a candidate for a bounded measured-geometry/dynamics fixture and shared observation prototype. Freeze calibration/construction/heldout splits and real-outcome cost comparison before new studies. Do not select batching or add realism based solely on these raw rates.
